_about: Published volume/bulk discount policies used as comparables by the bulk_order_discount tool. Collected 2026-10-14 by web search. Only entries with 'bulk': true count toward the benchmark; the others are shown for context.

competitors.name: University of Windsor Bookstore (departmental orders)
competitors.note: Larger special bulk orders get 25%, but the threshold isn't published, so it isn't used.

competitors.name: Agon Swim (custom wholesale orders)
competitors.note: 12+ units earn 15/25/30% depending on the retailer's annual volume; the entry-level 15% is used since this is a one-off order.

competitors.name: Stanford Student Store
competitors.note: Everyday student discount, not a bulk discount.

competitors.name: Rice University bookstore spirit items
competitors.note: Monthly 10% off designated spirit items; not a bulk discount.

competitors.name: Missouri State University bookstore
competitors.note: Student discount on clothing and logoed items; not a bulk discount.
